QuestInfo.name: [Ariant] Areda's Origins
QuestInfo.1: Carson explains that Areda was an apprentice alchemist under Russellon. The fundamental theory behind her Mandraky potion is based on her alchemist background. Carson proposed a deal to create an #bantidote#k for the Mandraky potion's effects.
QuestInfo.2: You received the antidote from Carson and returned to Jano in Ariant.
QuestInfo.0: Areda was kicked out of Ellinel Fairy Academy for impersonation, among other crimes. In truth, she's from Magatia, the town of alchemists. When you ask Carson about her, he has an unusual response...
